description: Trigger eval for the generative-principle skill. `should_trigger` prompts must load the skill; `should_not_trigger` prompts must NOT (the comment on each names the skill that should win instead). The two lists must stay disjoint. Run with scripts/run_evals.py.
should_trigger: explore the number 8 in the UNC
what's the generative move from 7 to 14?
deepen number 11 — it's still just scaffolding
is this observation consistent with the generative grammar?
how does 13 get generated if it's prime and can't be factored?
work the movements into and out of 12
which pillar does 15 sit on and why
test whether every prime can be reached by a sequential moving-through step
I found a pattern across cards 6, 11, 13 — where would it live in the project?
run the Operator times Substance grammar on 18
what does the Generate/Produce rhythm say about why 2 is the only even prime that matters

should_not_trigger.prompt: what does the Tower mean as my card of the day
score this reading against my journal entry
let's talk about what surrender means to me right now
help me derive the Hermetic correspondences for Mercury
refactor this Python function to be faster
what's the brand color for the Mystic tier
